pick.headline: Soviet nuclear-powered satellite crashes in Canada
pick.summary: On January 24, 1978, the Soviet ocean-surveillance satellite Cosmos 954 re-entered the atmosphere and scattered radioactive debris across Canada's Northwest Territories.
pick.significance: The reactor-powered reconnaissance satellite exposed the hazards of military surveillance in space and led to a joint US-Canadian clean-up operation.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & North Africa Daily Report of January 27, 1978, carried a Cairo MENA commentary on the fall of Cosmos 954 in Canada, arguing for a UN space information center and against any state keeping secret what the Soviet Union had kept secret.
